1.title: 1. Introduction
1.p1: SOMOS Properties ("we", "our", or "the Company") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website
1.lawText: We comply with Law 81 of 2019 on Personal Data Protection (Republic of Panama) and international data protection regulations.

2.title: 2. Data We Collect
list1: Name, email, phone number, and address (via contact forms)
Property preferences and real estate interests
Messages and inquiries sent through the contact form
list2: Cookies and similar technologies: Information about your browser, operating system, referring URL, and visited pages
Google Analytics: Navigation behavior data (subject to consent)
Facebook Pixel: Conversion and behavior information (subject to consent)
IP Address: For security and analysis purposes

3.title: 3. How We Use Your Data
list: Respond to your inquiries and information requests
Send updates on properties, promotions, and special offers
Improve user experience and personalize content
Analyze trends and optimize the website
Comply with legal obligations and resolve disputes
Prevent fraud and illicit activities

4.title: 4. Legal Basis (Law 81 of 2019)
4.intro: The processing of your personal data is based on:
list: Consent: Provided by accepting this policy and our cookie banner
Contract execution: When you request information about properties
Legal obligation compliance: According to applicable Panamanian laws
Legitimate interest: Improving our services and user experience

5.title: 5. Data Sharing
5.intro: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties, except:
list: Service providers (email, hosting, analytics) under confidentiality agreements
Associated real estate agents (only if explicitly requested)
Legal or regulatory requirements from Panamanian authorities
Protection of rights, privacy, and security

6.title: 6. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
6.intro: We use cookies to improve your experience. Our
6.outro: allows you to personalize your experience:
list: Necessary cookies: Site functionality (no consent required)
Analytical cookies: Google Analytics (consent required)
Marketing cookies: Facebook Pixel, TikTok Pixel (consent required)

7.title: 7. Your Rights (Law 81 of 2019)
list: Access: Request a copy of your personal data
Rectification: Correct inaccurate information
Cancellation: Request deletion under certain circumstances
Opposition: Object to the processing of your data
Portability: Receive your data in a structured format
7.contactIntro: To exercise these rights, please contact

8.title: 8. Data Security
8.intro: We implement technical, administrative, and physical security measures to protect your data:
list: HTTPS encryption on all transmissions
Firewalls and intrusion detection systems
Restricted access to personal information
Regular staff training on privacy
8.disclaimer: However, no system is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security.

9.title: 9. Data Retention
list: Contact data: As long as you maintain interest in our services (max 2 years without contact)
Analytical data: 26 months (standard Google Analytics setting)
Cookies: Per browser settings (typically 1-2 years)

10.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
10.content: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. We will notify you of any significant changes by posting the updated policy on the Site. The "Last updated" date will be revised to reflect any changes.
